fidelity: F2a — Point Kinetics + Lumped Thermal with Doppler/Moderator Feedback and Load-Following
source: Duderstadt & Hamilton (1976) Nuclear Reactor Analysis, Wiley; Stacey (2007) Nuclear Reactor Physics 2nd ed.; Keepin (1965) Physics of Nuclear Kinetics; IAEA (2022) Advances in SMR Technology Developments; NuScale VOYGR Design Certification Application (2020); Ingersoll & Carelli (2020) Handbook of Small Modular Nuclear Reactors

unit.name: Generic 540 MWth / 180 MWe Integral PWR SMR (NuScale VOYGR-class)

P_thermal_rated.note: Reactor module rated thermal power (540 MWth)

P_elec_rated.note: Net electrical output at full load (180 MWe)

Lambda.note: Prompt neutron generation time (light-water thermal spectrum)

beta.note: Delayed neutron fractions, 6 groups (U-235); total beta = 0.006502 (Keepin 1965)

alpha_f.note: Fuel/Doppler reactivity coefficient (negative; slightly stronger than large PWR due to softer SMR spectrum)

alpha_m.note: Moderator-temperature reactivity coefficient (negative; large-magnitude MTC enables deep load-following)

T_inlet.note: Primary coolant cold-leg / core inlet temperature (258 C)

m_f_cp_f.note: Lumped fuel heat capacity m_f*cp_f (small core => low fuel thermal mass)

m_m_cp_m.note: Lumped primary coolant heat capacity (450 MJ/K scaled; integral vessel inventory, governs thermal inertia ~8 min)

m_dot_cp_c.note: Coolant mdot*cp (1900 kg/s * 5.4 kJ/kgK natural circulation; sets core dT ~63 K at full power: T_out-T_in)

natural_circulation.note: Coolant flow scales with sqrt(power) via buoyancy (NuScale has no primary pumps)

nat_circ_exponent.note: mdot ~ P^0.5 for buoyancy-driven natural circulation (Boussinesq, Todreas & Kazimi 2012)

nat_circ_min_frac.note: Floor on natural-circulation flow fraction at low power
